description: This file defines the Gantt class responsible for rendering a Gantt chart visualization, including generating HTML tables representing months, days, and tasks with date calculations.

classes.name: Gantt
classes.description: A class for creating and drawing Gantt charts with methods for rendering HTML tables, date calculations, and utility functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Gantt chart with start date, end date, and tasks, and triggers drawing if tasks are provided.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Generates HTML tables to visually represent the Gantt chart, including months, days, and tasks with their durations and dependencies.

methods.name: year_month
methods.description: Returns a nested array of years, months, and days between start and end dates.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Calculates the total number of days between two dates, inclusive.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Provides a human-readable difference between start and end dates in years, months, and days.

methods.name: substr_unicode
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a unicode string, supporting multibyte encoded strings.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Validates if a string is null, not set, or only whitespace.
